---
description: relate as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  relationships: How you feel about people, one entry per person, in one write.
  relationships.with: "The person, by name."
  relationships.text: "How you feel about them, in your own words."
  relationships.trust: "From -100 to 100, when useful."
  relationships.warmth: "From -100 to 100, when useful."
  relationships.respect: "From -100 to 100, when useful."
  relationships.fear: "From -100 to 100, when useful."
  relationships.drop: "true when there is nothing left to say about them; false to take it back."
  relationships.why: "Why it changed."
---
Sets how you feel about each person you name, in your own words, with trust, warmth, respect and fear where they help. What you send for a person stands over what you said before; what you leave out stays as it was. It belongs to this turn: if the turn is swiped or deleted, it goes. The answer gives how you now stand with each.
